subject: [hw] DONE K01
body:
Test command and last line:
    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_k01/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST K01 PASS 732/732 (violations 0)
Three builds: ASan+UBSan, plain -O2, TSan; 732 checks each, violations 0. The register model (phone q10hw1 read-backs as defaults) fails on any VEN/larb/encoder access while off/protected/gated, wrong geometry/control/quality, DMA outside the 40 MiB claim, display-SMI writes, and injected copyin/copyout faults.

Kernel compile: integrated 0298+0299 tree with the current K01/K02/IK files in the real order (relay -> vcodec -> jpegdev), xnu_staged_compile.py CI flags, -Wall -Wextra -Werror: exit 0, 0 errors/warnings, 1,309,000-byte sweet_touch.o. hw-ik's compile_check.sh also passed on the 11:26 patch state.

Implemented: /dev/redwood-jpeg 0666 at nord2_input_init; RWJ_INFO (pure _IOR), RWJ_ENCODE per include/redwood_jpeg.h with every limit, one job at a time with interruptible sleepers, source repack to align16(width) with right/bottom padding (NV12/NV21/YUYV/YVYU), quality table, restart interval, EXIF bit, power-on demand with the model sequences, 100 us polling (2 s bound), result checks, EOI cut in the last 64 bytes, copyout, stats, 3 s idle thread-call power-off, RWJ_DECODE->ENOTSUP. 40 MiB claim: 24 MiB source + 16 MiB output. hw-k02 hook (n2jd_share_ven) accepted and wired: with it I call n2vc_ven_get, set only vencsys bit 8 + n2j_bus, never n2j_power/off, and clear bit 8 before n2vc_ven_put.

Not done / honest gaps:
1. No phone run. Host-tested and kernel-compiled only.
2. 4032x3024 (12.6 MP) single-job block limit not measured; no strips implemented (per TASK, not before measurement). Asked hw-lead for the autotest/device test.
3. EXIF flag semantics and restart-interval output not measured on the block; I program CTRL bit 5 and bit 10 + RST_MCU_NUM (accept 0..0xffff; Linux V4L2 caps callers at 100).
4. YUYV requests whose 16-pixel-padded packed size exceeds the 24 MiB source are EINVAL; 4096x3072 YUYV is exactly 24 MiB and fits. NV12 max sizes fit (~19 MiB).
5. VEN interleaving with K02 (a VENC job during a JPEG power-up/down) is only modelled on the host.
6. INFO.powered means this driver holds its VEN setup, not the raw SPM bit. Autotest command 7 shares the model n2j mapping; do not run it concurrently with the device. If thread_call_allocate fails, the domain stays on after the first job (logged).

Files changed (new, uncommitted): gpu/hwcodec/kern/bsd/dev/nord2_jpegdev.inc; gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_k01/t_jpegdev.c; gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_k01/run_tests.sh; gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/K01/STATUS.md. STATUS has the phone test order, expected log lines and pass criteria (IK/T02 can lift it). No phone, no vendor binaries, no publish.
